title: Triangles
subtitle: Understanding Congruence and Properties of Triangles
subject: Mathematics
author: Shine Academy EduOS AI
learning_outcomes: Define congruence of triangles and understand its meaning.
Apply SAS, ASA, AAS, SSS, and RHS criteria for congruence.
Utilize CPCT to solve geometric problems.

ai_context.learning_goal: Master the criteria for triangle congruence and apply them to prove equal parts in geometric figures.
common_misconceptions: Assuming ASS or SSA is a valid congruence criterion.
Mismatched vertex order when writing congruence statements.
Applying RHS to non-right angled triangles.
ai_context.tutor_hint: If the student struggles to identify congruent triangles, ask: 'Can you list the corresponding sides and angles that are given as equal? Which criterion does this match?'
